channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: British Pound flat below 217.00 as JPY intervention risks cap gains; bullish bias intact
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross struggles to gain any meaningful traction and seesaws between tepid gains/minor losses through the early part of the European session on Tuesday.

item.title: Gold: Oil spike weighs on prices – OCBC
item.description: OCBC strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong highlight that Gold has dropped toward 4000 as renewed US–Iran tensions pushed Oil sharply higher, reviving inflation concerns and lifting US yields.

item.title: WTI rises above $80.00 as US launches strikes, Iran disrupts shipping
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price continues to gain ground, trading around $80.20 per barrel during the European hours on Tuesday. Crude oil prices rise due to rising supply concerns, which could be attributed to the escalating United States (US)-Iran tensions.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Waiting for Australian data before RBA – Commerzbank
item.description: Volkmar Baur at Commerzbank notes the Australian Dollar (AUD) has traded largely sideways, with markets waiting for clarity on Middle East developments and upcoming Australian labor and inflation data ahead of the August 11 Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) meeting.

item.title: Forex Today: Eyes on US inflation data and Fed Chair Warsh testimony as Oil prices surge
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Tuesday, July 14:

item.title: Oil: Hormuz tensions drive price surge – ING
item.description: ING strategists Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey highlight sharply higher Oil prices as US–Iran tensions escalate and vessel traffic through the Strait of Hormuz slows.

item.title: Australian Dollar treads water above 0.6900, amid the risk-off market mood
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) posts moderate gains against the US Dollar on Tuesday, bouncing to the 0.6930 area from session lows near 0.6910.

item.title: British Pound: Advance has ended with range trade likely against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann highlight that GBP/USD gapped lower, dropping to 1.3343 and closing at 1.3346 as the Dollar firmed.

item.title: United States Dollar Index Price Forecast: Holds above 101.00 ahead of US CPI, Fed's Warsh
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, sticks to modest intraday losses through the early European session on Tuesday as bulls seem hesitant ahead of the latest US consumer inflation figures.

item.title: US Dollar: Data-dependent Fed stance and volatile pricing – BNY
item.description: BNY Markets’ John Velis and David Tam note that June Consumer Price Index (CPI) is expected to show softer headline inflation on lower energy, but recent events have lifted Oil prices again, complicating short-term forecasts.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Asset flows and valuation support – DBS
item.description: DBS Group Research economist Chang Wei Liang analyses long-term Japanese Yen valuation using DBS’s DEER framework, highlighting that JPY remains significantly undervalued near historically weak levels.

item.title: Indian Rupee slumps as US considers itself rightful recipient of Hormuz toll fees
item.description: The Indian Rupee trades significantly lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday. The USD/INR pair posts a fresh seven-week high near 96.13 as surging oil prices and United States (US) Treasury Yields due to threats of levy from Washington have weakened the appeal of the Indian currency.

item.title: British Pound drifts higher to near 1.3350 ahead US CPI data
item.description: The GBP/USD pair gains ground to around 1.3355 during the early European trading hours on Tuesday.

item.title: Equities: Chip slump and oil surge weigh – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank strategists report that US equities, particularly tech and semiconductor names, sold off as Oil prices spiked and AI-related sentiment softened.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD trades higher around $58 in countdown to US CPI data
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) is up 0.75% to near $58 during the European trading session on Tuesday.

item.title: Indian Rupee: Higher Oil and trade risks weigh on INR – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Dr. Henry Hao and Moses Lim highlight that India’s June Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose to 4.4% year-on-year, driven by food and fuel, while the trade deficit widened to USD30.4bn.

item.title: Gold approaches $4,050 on softer USD; looks to US CPI, Fed's Warsh for fresh impetus
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) recovers further from a nearly two-week low, touched earlier this Tuesday, and climbs above the $4,030 level heading into the European session.

item.title: Japanese Yen edges up against the US Dollar but remains close to 40-year lows
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) is trimming losses against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, as the USD/JPY pair retreats to the 162.30 area at the European session opening, down from session highs near 162.50.

item.title: Gold: Fed inflation fears weigh on prices – ING
item.description: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey say Gold and Silver have sold off as Middle East tensions lift Oil and reinforce concerns over persistent inflation and a tighter Federal Reserve policy path.

item.title: Euro: Downside bias but key support holds against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann report that EUR/USD slid to 1.1377 and closed at 1.1381, a two‑week low, as the Dollar strengthened ahead of United States (US) Consumer Price Index (CPI).

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Brace for a further sell-off toward 1.1200
item.description: The Euro (EUR) is up 0.12% to near 1.1395 against the US Dollar (USD) during the early European trading session on Tuesday. The major currency pair rises as the US Dollar corrects ahead of the United States (US) Consumer Price Index (CPI) data for June, which will be published at 12:30 GMT.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah gains as S&P’s stable ‘BBB’ rating boosts investor confidence
item.description: USD/IDR depreciates after registering gains in the previous day, trading around 18,140 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) stabilizes against the US Dollar (USD), buoyed by a rally in domestic equities.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Grinds higher above 112.50, yet stays constrained by mildly bearish bias
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross gathers strength to near 112.55 during the early European trading hours on Tuesday.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Hits four-week top on hawkish RBNZ; eyes 0.5810-0.5820 confluence
item.description: The NZD/USD pair catches aggressive bids during the Asian session on Tuesday and jumps to a nearly four-week top in the last hour amid a combination of supporting factors.

item.title: Swiss Franc advances as US Dollar slips despite Fed rate hike odds
item.description: USD/CHF declines after two days of gains, trading around 0.8140 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. Traders will likely observe the Swiss Producer and Import Prices data for June due later in the day.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Gains ground to near 185.00, holding modest bullish bias above key support
item.description: The EUR/JPY cross trades in positive territory around 184.90 during the early European trading hours on Tuesday.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in India on Tuesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Advances to four-week top, near $80.00 on Hormuz supply risks
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – is seen building on the previous day's strong move up and gaining positive traction for the second consecutive day on Tuesday.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Tests nine-day EMA barrier near 0.6950
item.description: AUD/USD edges higher after posting 0.5% losses in the previous day, trading around 0.6930 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The technical analysis of the daily chart shows the pair remaining within the descending channel pattern, suggesting a prevailing bearish bias.

item.title: China’s June Trade Balance: Surplus widens sharply amid strong exports
item.description: China's Trade Balance for June, in Chinese Yuan (CNY) terms, arrives at CNY859.05 billion, widening from the previous figure of CNY723.98 billion.
